title: Trinity and Roswell crashes

tellings.quote: Known crashes like those at Trinity and Roswell

plain: Michels speaks of crashes at Trinity, the New Mexico site of the first atomic bomb test, and at Roswell, a New Mexico town, in the 1940s as "known crashes" of unidentified craft. He tells this himself, without naming a source, as a starting point for talk about recovered craft. If true, it would mean the United States got hold of crashed objects close to the very start of the nuclear age.
